taskDescription: Arrange the steps of the cough reflex arc in the correct physiological sequence, from stimulus detection to explosive expulsion.
paragraphs: Irritant stimuli activate rapidly adapting receptors (RARs) and C-fibre nociceptors in the airway mucosa
Afferent impulses travel via the vagus nerve and superior laryngeal nerve to the medullary cough centre
The medullary cough centre integrates afferent input and generates the efferent motor command
Inspiratory phase — a deep inspiration fills the lungs to generate adequate expulsive force
Compressive phase — the glottis closes while expiratory muscles contract, building intrathoracic pressure
Expulsive phase — the glottis opens abruptly, producing high-velocity airflow that expels irritants
